title: Shared worktree bootstrap archive: the pack plan and the entries sidecar

PackPlan.description: Which files of .git/objects/pack the bootstrap archive carries when it copies packs. keep: stems of packs that hold at least one object no larger kept pack holds (and every pack whose index cannot be read); covered: stems whose every object is in a kept pack; orphans: stems with a pack without index or an index without pack; garbage: names that never belong in an archive (tmp_*, *.lock, multi-pack-index*, unknown files).

objects.description: Objects in the kept packs, duplicates between kept packs included.

EntriesSidecar.description: worktree-<16 hex>.entries next to worktree-<16 hex>.tar: UTF-8 text, one line per archived file outside .git/objects/pack, sorted by path: path TAB sha256 TAB bytes TAB (x or -) LF. The next build compares the store manifest with it to measure how much changed.
